Definition: properly, to point sharply, i.e. (literally) to wound; figuratively, to be alert, to decide
BiblicalUsage: 1) to cut, sharpen, decide, decree, determine, maim, move, be decisive, be mutilated; 1a)(Qal); 1a1) to cut, mutilate; 1a2) to sharpen; 1a3) to decide; 1b) (Niphal) to be decisive
